finding.observation: The canonical encoder defines every nonzero q8 scale as Fraction.from_float(max_abs)/127, but the pre-delta validator admitted any reduced rational whose 127*scale merely rounded to a positive finite binary64. Therefore a self-consistent packet with a recomputed packet digest could use a finite rational scale that no finite-binary64 source vector can cause the canonical encoder to emit.
finding.hypothesis: One JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 wire language should admit only scale rationals in the exact image of the canonical finite-binary64 encoder.
finding.counterhypothesis: Digest identity, reduced-rational form, finite 127*scale and the full-q8 anchor already define a sufficiently canonical wire language even when scale*127 is not exactly representable as binary64.
finding.discriminator: Require Fraction.from_float(float(scale*127)) == scale*127 after digest verification, then encode ordinary binary64 vectors and reject a newly hash-consistent non-encoder-native rational such as scale=1/3.

delta.law_added: For every nonzero admitted vector-control packet, anchor_fraction=scale*127 must equal Fraction.from_float(float(anchor_fraction)); otherwise reject SCALE_RATIONAL_BINARY64_ANCHOR_EXACT_REQUIRED.
